theorem Shellsort.F09.ArcAveraging.averaged_heat_error (G : Nat) (hG : LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) G) (A : Nat → Real) :
  forall {lam0 lam s e : Real},
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) lam0 → LE.le lam0 lam → LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) s → LE.le s (OfNat.ofNat 1) → LE.le

    (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 4)
      (HDiv.hDiv e
        (Real.sqrt
          (HDiv.hDiv
            (HMul.hMul
              (HSub.hSub (OfNat.ofNat 1)

axiom propext {a b : Sort 0} : Iff a b → Eq a b

axiom Quot.sound.{u} {α : Sort u} {r : α → α → Sort 0} {a b : α} : r a b → Eq (Quot.mk r a) (Quot.mk r b)

axiom Classical.choice.{u} {α : Sort u} : Nonempty α → α
